# Development tracking labels

These labels support tracking work across the public repository.

| Label | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `bug` | Broken behavior or unexpected errors |
| `enhancement` | New features or improvements |
| `security` | Security-related issues (use Security Advisories for private reports) |
| `docs` | Documentation updates |
| `good first issue` | Small, well-scoped fixes for new contributors |
| `needs review` | Waiting for maintainer or operator review |
